puzzle.hint: A powerful verse that combines tawhid (the oneness of Allah) with the command of tawakkul (placing full reliance upon Him).
puzzle.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
puzzle.verseEn: Allāh - there is no deity except Him. And upon Allāh let the believers rely.
